messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD-45891 — 30% error rate increased for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Escalation policy 'prod-latency-tier' fired. Primary on-call paged.

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident PD-45891 created by monitoring. Escalating to primary on-call (sre-oncall).

sre-oncall: ugh, i'm in DND (travel). got the page but it didn't wake me, was expecting a handoff. give me 2 mins to check my phone. :zzz:

alex: seeing 502 spikes on hosted API dashboards, per-route spike to models/redwood-base-2. error traces show `kv-cache` timeouts. Customers reporting failed embeddings. ETA on ack?

maya: @sre-oncall if you can't pick up, PD should escalate to secondary (ryan) then manager. we already hit PD escalation timer (5m).

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: secondary on-call ryan paged (PD-45891). Manager notify queue will trigger if still unacked in 5 minutes.

ryan: on it, just woke up. pulling logs now. first glance: increased tail latency from a deploy at 00:42 UTC. Also seeing autoscaler thrash.

alex: rollback candidate? last deploy looks like `api/serve v2.14.3` at 00:42.

ryan: rolling back that deploy to v2.14.2 now. running: `kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/api-server --to-revision=2`

incident-bot: Deploy rollback started by ryan. Notifying PD.

maya: I'm starting a quick mitigation: disable autoscale for model-pool-eu temporarily and pin to current GPU count to stop thrashing. Command: `redwoodctl pool update model-pool-eu --autoscale=false --replicas=6`

ryan: rollback in progress, fetching health checks...

[logs pasted by ryan]
```
2024-06-22T00:47:12Z api-server[pid=2234] WARN kv-cache: request timeout after 3000ms
2024-06-22T00:47:13Z autoscaler INFO scaling action rejected due to flapping
2024-06-22T00:48:01Z api-server INFO started listen on 0.0.0.0:8080 v2.14.2
2024-06-22T00:48:06Z proxy INFO 200 /v1/generate latency=120ms
```

ryan: rollback finished. initial checks look good — error rate dropping from 32% -> 4% in last 3 minutes.

incident-bot: PagerDuty notice: PD-45891 acknowledged by ryan at 00:49 UTC. Escalation halted.

alex: customer-impact note: Affected subset: Hosted API customers in eu-west-1 (embed-heavy workloads). Estimated impact window: 00:42–00:49 UTC. Roughly ~2.4k failed requests. No data exfiltration, upstream retries possible.

maya: fine to close once we confirm stabilization for 15m and run regression evals on v2.14.2 vs v2.14.3 prompts. I'll open a short post-incident checklist.

ops-manager: Thanks team. Two quick follow-ups: 1) add a PD runbook entry for autoscaler flapping detection and a forced-scaling fallback, 2) enforce 2-person on-call wake chain for overnight windows (primary + secondary). I'll file the task. Great work. :heavy_check_mark: 

ryan: leaving a short runbook note in the incident ticket with the rollback command and autoscale toggle.

sre-oncall: sorry for the delay — DND misconfig caused the page not to ring. I've updated my schedule and added device overrides.

alex: tagging for postmortem: @ops-manager @maya @ryan. I'll collect logs and the alerting graph and attach to the incident.

ops-manager: I'll schedule a 30-min blameless review tomorrow. Close PD when you confirm 15m stable.

incident-bot: PD-45891 status: monitoring (stabilized). Awaiting closure.

maya: confirmed 18m stable, error rate steady at ~1%. closing the loop: mitigation = rollback + pinning pool. Recommend follow-up: tweak autoscaler cooldowns and add explicit flapping guard.

ops-manager: closing notes added. PD incident can be resolved. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
